story_overview: In a records office, Marcus and Vincent have intense conversations with a concerned Leo and Casey. Later at a car wash, Vincent is confronted by Casey, while Marcus and Dustin look on. The story culminates with a troubled Ewan giving a public statement.

video_prompts:
Ewan: Man with reddish-brown hair and a full beard, wearing a dark collared shirt.
Marcus: Man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a black leather jacket.
Leo: Young man with curly blond hair, wearing a green and white plaid shirt.
The Records Office: Office interior with office furniture and filing cabinets.

Medium shot in The Records Office, near the metal filing cabinets. Marcus, wearing the black leather jacket, speaks intently to Leo, wearing the green plaid shirt, who listens, his expression growing concerned. Ewan stands nearby, shifting his weight slightly as he observes the conversation.

Vincent: Man with longer brown hair and a prominent mustache, wearing a brown jacket over a blue sweater.
Casey: A person with short hair, wearing a light-colored shirt and a light-colored jacket.

Close-up on Vincent in The Records Office, speaking directly to the camera, with the Dutch text overlay. In the background, Leo, wearing the green plaid shirt, shuffles some papers near the metal filing cabinets, and Casey, wearing the light-colored shirt and a light-colored jacket, types at a desk.

Over-the-shoulder medium shot in The Records Office. Vincent stands with his back to the camera, speaking to Casey. Casey faces forward, listening with a serious and concerned expression, slowly nodding. In the background, Leo shifts his weight as he observes the conversation.
Close-up of Vincent in The Records Office, under the Dutch text overlay. He slowly looks down, his expression turning pensive. Leo stands slightly behind him, out of focus.
In a close-up, Vincent looks down with a somber expression in The Records Office. In the soft-focus background, Leo moves around a desk near the metal filing cabinets.

the crumpled office reports: Multiple loose, rectangular sheets of white office paper with black printed text and graphs, some slightly crumpled or creased.

Leo kneels on the floor, frantically gathering scattered sheets of the crumpled office reports. Vincent stands over him, watching intently and shifting his weight. In the background, Casey sits at a desk near the metal filing cabinets, occasionally glancing towards Leo and Vincent.
